items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Bessie Lawson and Ophie Harrington and Mabel Durham and a couple of the girls, they lived across the street from me and when I got out to go to the store or anything I noticed they'd come out of the house and go to the store with me.

ctx.x: Buzzin the Buzz and Harris show. We were traveling and it seems I was so tiny that - I said to you once before that one of the musicians grabbed me and threw me up in the air, just grabbed me and kissed me and kissed me. The reason I'm afraid of a knife, someone pulls a knife out I'll faint almost, because our trumpet player's wife happened to be around and when he did that, she pulled a razor out on me. I was nothing but a little girl. I became so frightened. Then her husband put me down and she hit me. I…

One other time that I ran into something like that, my husband was very tall, handsome ladies' man and he was always teasing. He had one girl in Tulsa, Oklahoma, thinking that he was going to marry her, but his wife wouldn't allow it. I knew nothing about it and the wives were protecting me in the Andy Kirk band and I didn't know it.
